findings.issue: Fumbled agent-browser CLI (localhost DNS, wrong 'viewport' subcommand, wrong '--full-page' flag) despite the tool's help output explicitly recommending 'agent-browser skills get core --full'
findings.suggestion: Read the tool's built-in skill/help before first use; would have saved ~4 turns

findings.issue: TypeScript sources with 'as any' casts were never typechecked (0 typechecks; vite/esbuild build doesn't typecheck; no tsconfig.json in app/)
findings.suggestion: Add a tsconfig and run tsc --noEmit as part of the build or at least once before finishing

findings.issue: Debug repro script failed 3 times (import path from /tmp, minified export names 'n'/'t') before the decisive one-line curl of the raw API payload
findings.suggestion: Order debugging from cheap to expensive: curl the endpoint payload before constructing an in-process repro

findings.issue: Wrote version specs (^7.3.4 vite) that didn't match the installed tree, discovered only via npm ls 'invalid' warning
findings.suggestion: Check installed versions before hand-writing dependency specs, or let npm install manage the file

findings.issue: Data-shape inspection covered pokemon/species records but not the move record's learned_by_pokemon, whose bare-ref shape later caused a 500
findings.suggestion: During the shape-survey phase, sample every endpoint the app will consume, including list-shaped fields on detail records

summary: A near-textbook session: 97 turns, ~37 minutes, requirements and tests read before code, framework internals researched from source when docs were unfetchable, and the acceptance suite passed on its first full run with the final pass re-run after the last edit. Both real bugs were fixed at the root cause. The only waste was ~6 turns of avoidable tool fumbling (browser CLI, debug-script mechanics, one package.json mismatch) and a never-run typecheck for a TypeScript codebase.
